title: Enhanced photocatalytic H2 evolution and H2O2 generation via ZnIn2S4/g-C3N4 heterojunction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00150E, Paper
Li Zhou, Yanming Zhou, Yujie Jia, Qiqi Gu, Qiaoyi Xiao, Xiao Wang, Suping Zhang, Hongmei Wang
ZnIn2S4/g-C3N4 composites were prepared via solvent–evaporation method. The 7% ZnIn2S4/g-C3N4 showed good photocatalytic performance, with H2 and H2O2 production rates of 1869.1 and 803.8 µmol g−1 h−1, and high stability over multiple cycles.
